p: Pittman will participate in Wednesday's practice and his status will be reflected on the injury report.
Pittman was being evaluated, so the Wednesday injury report designation is worth checking before lineup decisions.
Pittman's role could shrink because he has been fighting through injuries and others may get opportunities.
A banged-up WR2 who hadn't yet found a rhythm with Rodgers is a risk to hold.
Pittman will keep producing as a reliable complement in the passing game after making the most of his limited opportunities.
McCarthy singled out Pittman as the one receiver who made the most of his chances, and said some receivers got more chances than others.
I thought Michael Pittman did a nice job making the best of his opportunities.
